Today is #WorldMentalHealthDay — and none of us are immune.

I’ve dealt with anxiety myself, and I know how hard it can be to find support when you need it.

That’s why I joined @RepBonnie  to introduce the Mental Health Emergency Package—three bills that strengthen crisis response, expand care, and save lives.

Because people in crisis deserve care, not criminalization. 💚

If you or someone you know is struggling, call or text 988 for free, confidential help.

Celebrating Native heritage all weekend ahead of #IndigenousPeoplesDay on Monday — from the Downtown Phoenix Night Market to Native Health’s Open House and Health Fair.

See what’s going on in #AZ03 ⬇️ https://t.co/fNb5ILemIj

‼️ It’s Day 12 of the Trump Shutdown.‼️ Millions of Americans across the country are now receiving notices with massive premium increases because of the Republican health care crisis. 

Yet @SpeakerJohnson wants @HouseGOP to stay on vacation. Make that make sense? https://t.co/K2mgIXwyJN

While we wait for Trump and Republicans to work with us to end their shutdown and fix the health care crisis they’ve created, my office is a resource to serve you. 

Please reach out to us at https://t.co/aI5lm9mA0r https://t.co/khQV2iTc2B

I called my constituents to hear directly how the Trump and Republican health care crisis and government shutdown are hurting our community. They have a few thoughts for @SpeakerJohnson. https://t.co/Tf3GExSBEv

My constituent Yari, who has cancer, has been detained since Feb 10, and her health has deteriorated severely.

Proud to stand with Trans Queer Pueblo and grassroots orgs today demanding her release. I’ll never stop fighting for Yari & every person suffering at the hands of ICE. https://t.co/IwtON9SZ0d

While millions of Americans are missing paychecks and losing health care, Donald Trump is building himself a $350 million palace funded by corporations and billionaires buying influence. It’s disgusting. 

I’m demanding answers with @RepRobertGarcia and @RepHuffman. https://t.co/2cdUSR9YsK

After our office demanded that ICE allow Yari to see an oncologist for her cancer, they finally did. Now they’re withholding her medical results.

This is unacceptable. Yari is in critical condition. We demand her release and immediate treatment now. https://t.co/tSFQsX188T

Donald Trump and Republicans have waged a war against access to health care and food in the United States. We won’t stand for it.

Grateful for the conversation with @nativehealthphx and their tireless work to keep Arizonans healthy. https://t.co/J8kI0UsRMG

The Republican health care crisis can’t be pushed off for later. 

We need real action now. Republicans haven’t even shown up in DC, and Trump’s number one priority isn’t ending this shutdown, it’s building his $350 million ballroom. https://t.co/7KdMp9SPRO

Federal judges just ruled Trump must release the billions in SNAP funding he’s illegally withholding.

Heading home to Phoenix to support the food banks and community health centers making sure families have what they need. https://t.co/QO1edD0ddA

I'm here outside @SpeakerJohnson’s office because he is starving families and gutting health care to cover up the Epstein Files.

Change my mind. https://t.co/RFlSTOVVSr

Trump’s attacks on healthcare have been devastating.

I visited @terroshealth in Phoenix this week—a community health center stretched to the brink by cuts to Medicaid and food assistance.

We should be strengthening these lifelines, not starving them. https://t.co/qmtpLe16J9

On #VeteransDay, I honor our veterans and the families who stood beside them. 

In Congress, I’m fighting to expand VA care, housing, and mental health support, and to stop the deportation of veterans carried out by Trump.

We take care of those who defended us. https://t.co/N2qaNsNSmS

Yari’s suffering at Eloy isn’t an isolated case. It’s the product of systemic abuse, medical neglect, and shredded due process. As @ImmDef President Lindsay Toczylowski told @OversightDems: it’s past time for a top-to-bottom investigation of ICE prisons so people stop dying on this government’s watch.

We’re exposing the abuse inside private prison-run detention centers like Eloy in Arizona.

In my Q&A with the Florence Immigration Project, I pressed on the rampant medical neglect putting people’s lives at risk. Their advocacy for Yari and countless others is essential. https://t.co/viww7U2t3O

This week, for the first time since 1988, the Trump Administration didn't recognize #WorldAIDSDay. I'm proud to lead the HIV Medication Act, which prevents this Administration’s ideological attacks on PEPFAR and resumes its full spectrum of services. https://t.co/krAoAhue7O

.@SpeakerJohnson is sending Congress home for the holidays without voting on a 3-year ACA tax credit extension—putting affordable health care at risk for millions.

Conveniently timed just before Trump’s DOJ is required to release the Epstein files.

This is all unacceptable.
We’re outside the @DHSgov @ICEgov field office in Phoenix demanding the urgent release of my constituent, Yari, who’s dying of leukemia and needs medical care NOW. #FreeYari https://t.co/03d2BrRuQE

Seven people died in ICE custody this month alone—four in just four days. It’s heartbreaking, shameful, and preventable.

I’m demanding the release of my constituent, Yari, who is battling leukemia, coughing up blood, and being denied proper medical care in detention. https://t.co/GsETYyP4CD
